text.tspan: Two-way traffic (both sides START calls): what each option needs
Both VPCs join one service network.
NLB + endpoint service on each side.
NAT + NLB on EACH side (4 desks).
Full two-way: any port, any protocol,
Replies never need extra setup: they follow the existing connection. Only STARTING a call from the other side does.
